ruleDefinitions.name: Creation Of A Local User Account
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the creation of a new user account. Such accounts may be used for persistence that do not require persistent remote access tools to be deployed on the system.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\/dscl$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*create.*")) OR (process_path = RGX("\\/sysadminctl$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*addUser.*")))
